summary: Per-frame processor for a pit-crew related object array: when the pending flag (bit 0 at this+0) is set, iterates the array at this[4] (120-byte stride, entry address +100), calls Bit12FlagSet on each non-null entry, and conditionally runs UIWidgetRecursiveStateUpdate when detail level dword_7CF884 >= 2 and this[5] is non-zero. Clears flag bits 0-1 at the end.

operations.description: Pending-flag guard: the whole body runs only when bit 0 of the byte at this+0 is set.
Read the element count from this[3] (this+0xC); when it is not greater than 0 the loop body is skipped.
Iterate the array anchored at this[4] (this+0x10): each entry at index*120 + 100 bytes, stepping 120 bytes per element.
For each non-null array entry, set bit 12 on that pit-crew object via Bit12FlagSet.
Conditional UI update: requires the detail-level global dword_7CF884 to be >= 2 and this[5] (this+0x14) to be non-zero.
Recursively update widget visibility with UIWidgetRecursiveStateUpdate(0, 0, 0).
Acknowledge the pending flag by clearing bits 0-1 at this+0 with mask 0xFFFFFFFC.

unresolved: The concrete type and identity of the objects in the array (entry address +100, 120-byte stride) are not established from this function alone.
Whether Bit12FlagSet's bit-12 set activates or enables the object is DERIVED from the surrounding fill and not proven here.
Semantics of this[5] (UI-update enable) beyond a non-zero check are unknown.
